text: The researchers said you put all your eggs in one basket, then drop the basket when it gets heavy.
Cairn watches the eggs hit the floor.
That is the whole warning in one picture.
Urging people to find their passion can put all the eggs in one basket.
Then a heavy night becomes a reason to drop it.
The eggs were never the problem.
The drop was.
Tuesday put the eggs in.
Thursday judged the basket by its weight.
The floor gets a mess that used to be a plan.
Cairn will not drop this basket tonight.
A heavy paragraph is not a sign to switch lives.
It is a sign to keep the hands on the work.
Hard is a load.
Wrong is a verdict.
Cairn carries the load.
He does not issue the verdict.
If a friend asks whether this is still the one, Cairn answers with the session, not with the mood.
The eggs can stay in the basket while the basket is heavy.
That is the picture.
He is still in the room while they fall, so he can refuse the drop even as he watches it.
